text:
george: Quick preflight for Monday's announce. Need final changelog link, docs preview with runnable snippets, exact canary schedule, HubSpot tag + routing, and the 1-line engineering quote. Embargo 08:00 UTC. Can eng confirm plan? @leah
leah: Confirming. Proposed ramp: 2% x 10m -> 12% x 20m -> 40% x 30m -> 100% if green. Abort triggers: 5xx > 0.7% OR p95 > 340ms. Will post a short canary playbook URL in 20m.
nina: Docs preview ready: https://docs.redwood.ai/previews/221. Includes curl + TS quickstarts, and a short migration note for rwd-serve-v2 -> v3. I left the model string placeholder; will update once leah confirms.
george: Marketing will pull that preview into the blog draft. Need the changelog commit/hash to cite and the short benchmark bullets (p50/p95 + token cost delta) for the header.
sam: For inbound, use HubSpot tag `launch_mono`. Routing: tag -> marketing/sdr queue. Escalation if usage>60 reqs/day or trial created -> sales/tier1 via webhook. I'll paste the rule IDs after this thread.
leah: Changelog draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/commit/uvw123. Blurb: "Adaptive prefix cache + smarter batching to cut tail latency and unit token cost for long-context runs." Take it or tweak.
nina: Added a short code block in the docs preview for the quickstart. Will swap in `model: rwd-serve-v3` after you confirm, leah.
george: Marketing timeline: blog live T+0, quick thread +10, short demo clip + webinar CTA at +45. Webinar landing: https://redwood.ai/webinar/stack-up. Can we include reg link in the CTA?
sam: Yes, include it. HubSpot rule IDs: marketing/queue/5301, escalation/webhook/8842. I'll confirm the webhook payload so we can test during dry-run.
leah: Confirm model name: rwd-serve-v3. Also: APAC staged 30m after global full rollout to avoid cache thrash. I'll post the canary checklist (health checks + rollback commands) in 10m.
george: Can we run a 15m dry-run T-30m before publish? Need folks to sanity-check dashboards and the webinar CTA flow.
leah: Yes dry-run at T-25m works for me. I'll bring the health dashboard and the rollback steps. Checklist: canary traffic, top error traces, p50/p95 latency, token-time tail.
nina: I'll rehearse the quickstart and the migration note during dry-run. Also will ensure the docs permalink is stable: https://docs.redwood.ai/previews/221#final after model string is set.
george: Marketing needs a 1-line quote from eng for the blog header. Leah?
leah: "This release reduces tail latency for long-context inference by combining adaptive prefix caching with smarter batching, improving responsiveness and lowering token cost for production workloads." Use verbatim.
deploy-bot: [deploy-schedule] canary requested by leah for 2026-06-14T07:30:00Z
george: Perfect. I'll lock the blog draft once the changelog hash and final docs permalink are pasted here, and I'll schedule the T-30m embargo ping in #marketing. :rocket:
